pages.lesson:
LESSON: PARABLE OF THE LOST COIN

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ:
Topic 3.8.1: Parable of the lost coin

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Parable of the lost coin. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does God show love for the sinner?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the parable of the lost coin
2. recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life
3. appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PARABLE OF THE LOST COIN
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Parable of the lost coin helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PARABLE OF THE LOST COIN
Study Parable of the lost coin like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Retell the parable of the lost coin

What this means
In this part you learn to retell the parable of the lost coin. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: retell the parable of the lost coin.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Parable of the lost coin” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can retell the parable of the lost coin. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life

What this means
In this part you learn to recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Parable of the lost coin in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Parable of the lost coin is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Parable of the lost coin” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: retell the parable of the lost coin)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Parable of the lost coin in your own words. (skill: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Parable of the lost coin to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: retell the parable of the lost coin.
3. Practise this skill: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Parable of the lost coin from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Parable of the lost coin: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Parable of the lost coin?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does God show love for the sinner?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Parable of the lost coin means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: retell the parable of the lost coin.
5. Be able to: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
